items.text: This is literally the worst game I have ever played. I like story games. There are many good examples of this style game. This is not one, its a monologue by a whiny entitled nice guy. Don't be fooled by the 'mixed' reviews. The only positive reviews are people mocking the game.  Do not waste your time or money.
items.text_zh: 这确实是我玩过的最糟糕的游戏。我喜欢故事游戏。这种风格的游戏有很多好例子。这不是其中之一，它是一个爱抱怨、自以为是的好人的独白。不要被“褒贬不一”的评测骗了。唯一的好评是人们在嘲笑这个游戏。 不要浪费你的时间或金钱。
